# Global Software Discovery MVP

Global Software Discovery is a public web-first MVP for discovering useful personal software through problems, product facts, transparent signals, and community backing.

Primary URL:
https://katsuraco.github.io/global-software-discovery-temp/

Purpose:
The site tests a living discovery loop for useful software:
problem -> demand -> product -> try -> use -> backing -> history.

Current MVP surfaces:
- Homepage / Product Wall
- Product detail pages
- Need detail pages
- Profile / sign-in entry
- Seed products
- Seed needs
- Canonical product fact blocks
- Product Constitution blocks
- Product history blocks

Important product pages:
- KeePassXC: /products/keepassxc
- LocalSend: /products/localsend
- Paperless-ngx: /products/paperless-ngx
- Syncthing: /products/syncthing
- Actual Budget: /products/actual-budget
- Flameshot: /products/flameshot

Important need pages:
- Offline private family documents: /needs/offline-private-family-documents
- Quick local file transfer: /needs/quick-local-file-transfer
- Offline password vault: /needs/offline-password-vault

Core principle:
Good products should not lose because their creators cannot afford marketing.

Ranking and trust principles:
- Credibility cannot be bought.
- Account is not trust.
- Problems cannot be owned.
- Provenance is permanent.
- Sponsored reach must stay separate from organic discovery.
- Open source is a filter, not an automatic quality score.

Current limitation:
This is V1 seed content. Try, Save, Back, and Need confirmation are represented in the interface and schema, but full persistent user action flows are not complete yet.
